lines.speaker: 市民
lines.cn: 新会定了工价以后，手艺好的和手艺差的拿一样的钱。有人欢喜有人骂。
lines.en: Since the Guild set the rates, good hands and clumsy hands earn the same. Some cheer, some curse.

lines.speaker: 商贩
lines.cn: 布林的买卖看码头，码头看风向。风向一变，价就跟着变。
lines.en: Brynn's trade watches the docks, and the docks watch the wind. Wind shifts, prices follow.

lines.speaker: 卫兵
lines.cn: 夜里巡的是老楼那几条巷子。灯亮着的地方反而少去。
lines.en: Night patrols stick to the old-tower lanes. The well-lit spots we visit least.

lines.speaker: 工头
lines.cn: 城墙之内的事办完以后，工班换了两次人。换人不换活。
lines.en: After the matter inside the walls, the crew changed twice. The work did not.

lines.speaker: 渡工
lines.cn: 潮水退去以后，滩上的东西比水里多。捡的人也多。
lines.en: When the tide pulls back, the beach holds more than the water did. More pickers too.

lines.speaker: 农人
lines.cn: 村里的屋修了三回，塌了两回。第三回我们换了地基。
lines.en: The village house was rebuilt three times and fell twice. The third time we changed the foundation.

lines.speaker: 乡民
lines.cn: 夜里风从水面来，门要拴两道。
lines.en: At night the wind comes off the water. Two bolts on the door.

lines.speaker: 乡民
lines.cn: 潮水的事过去以后，码头照旧按潮水开。人倒是记得久一点。
lines.en: Once the tide business passed, the dock opened by the tide as always. People remembered longer.

lines.speaker: 农人
lines.cn: 留到来年的一袋种，谁家都有。借的时候说清楚，还的时候也清楚。
lines.en: Everyone keeps a sack of seed for next year. Clear terms when borrowing, clear terms when returning.

lines.speaker: 村长
lines.cn: 村里的事我管得细。细是因为人手少，不是因为我爱管。
lines.en: I run village matters close. Close because hands are few, not because I like it.

lines.speaker: 乡民
lines.cn: 夜里麦田里有动静，先看是风还是人。多半是风。
lines.en: Something moves in the wheat at night. First ask: wind or man. Mostly wind.

lines.speaker: 农人
lines.cn: 来年那一袋留住了以后，谁家借粮都写名字。写字比记性稳。
lines.en: Once next year's sack was kept, every loan got a name. Writing holds better than memory.

lines.speaker: 酒工
lines.cn: 没有年份的酒也能喝。就是喝的时候得说清是哪一批。
lines.en: Wine without a year drinks fine. You just have to say which batch it is.

lines.speaker: 学徒
lines.cn: 学院那边一开课，酒馆就空一半。散课以后又满回来。
lines.en: When the college holds lectures, half the tavern empties. When it lets out, it fills again.

lines.speaker: 店主
lines.cn: 夜里酒馆只卖不赊。赊出去的人，第二天就不来了。
lines.en: At night the tavern sells, never lends. Those who owe stop coming the next day.

lines.speaker: 酒工
lines.cn: 没有年份那件事之后，账上开始写批次。写批次，比写年份老实。
lines.en: After the business of the missing year, the ledger records batches. Batches are more honest than years.

lines.speaker: 匠人
lines.cn: 护甲里面的名字是缝在衬里的。不是给买主看的。
lines.en: The name inside the armour is stitched into the lining. Not for the buyer.

lines.speaker: 商贩
lines.cn: 这城的铺子看手艺，也看谁家师承。师承比手艺贵。
lines.en: Shops here judge hands, and also lineage. Lineage costs more.

lines.speaker: 学徒
lines.cn: 夜里炉子要压火。压不好，第二天整条街都是烟。
lines.en: At night the forge fire must be banked. Bank it badly and the whole street smokes.

lines.speaker: 匠人
lines.cn: 名字的事翻出来以后，有几家把衬里拆了重缝。拆的时候没人说话。
lines.en: After the names came out, a few houses unpicked their linings. Nobody spoke while they worked.

lines.speaker: 炉工
lines.cn: 第二次赎回的价，炉户们自己算了三遍。三遍三个数。
lines.en: The furnace men worked the second redemption price three times. Three times, three numbers.

lines.speaker: 乡民
lines.cn: 烟囱一停，半个镇子就没饭吃。停不停，不由我们定。
lines.en: Stop the stacks and half the town goes hungry. Whether they stop is not ours to decide.

lines.speaker: 炉工
lines.cn: 夜里炉温要看着。看着的人不许睡，睡了就换人。
lines.en: Someone watches the furnace heat at night. The watcher must not sleep; sleep and you are replaced.

lines.speaker: 乡民
lines.cn: 赎回的事定了以后，烟囱照旧冒烟。定了的只是账。
lines.en: With the redemption closed, the stacks smoked as before. Only the ledger changed.

lines.speaker: 牧人
lines.cn: 最后一匹家纹的布，是留着做样子的。不是留着穿的。
lines.en: The last bolt with the family crest is kept for a pattern, not for wearing.

lines.speaker: 织工
lines.cn: 羊毛的价看雨。雨多草好，毛就好，价就低。
lines.en: Wool prices follow rain. Good rain, good grass, good wool, low price.

lines.speaker: 织工
lines.cn: 夜里机子不能停。停了线就乱，乱了要拆半天。
lines.en: The loom must not stop at night. Stop and the thread tangles; untangling takes half a day.

lines.speaker: 牧人
lines.cn: 家纹的事办完以后，最后那匹布还在架上。谁都没动它。
lines.en: After the crest business, the last bolt stayed on the rack. Nobody touched it.

lines.speaker: 寄存人
lines.cn: 不是你的姓，就不能签你的名。这话写在墙上，也写在账上。
lines.en: If it is not your name, you cannot sign it. That is on the wall and in the ledger.

lines.speaker: 商贩
lines.cn: 寄存的货，认条不认人。条丢了，就认账上的日期。
lines.en: Stored goods answer to the slip, not the face. Lose the slip and the date in the ledger decides.

lines.speaker: 看守
lines.cn: 夜里库房只开一道门。开两道，就有人记不住关哪道。
lines.en: At night only one storeroom door opens. Two doors and nobody remembers which to shut.

lines.speaker: 寄存人
lines.cn: 姓的事说开以后，账上多了两栏：来处和去处。
lines.en: After the name business, the ledger gained two columns: where from, where to.

lines.speaker: 伐木工
lines.cn: 林线以外不许砍。不是规矩严，是砍了就没了。
lines.en: No cutting past the tree line. Not strictness - cut it and it is gone.

lines.speaker: 护林人
lines.cn: 林子认得脚印。走多了，那条路就自己长出来。
lines.en: The forest knows footprints. Walk often and the path grows itself.

lines.speaker: 伐木工
lines.cn: 夜里林子里有响动别追。多半是獾，也可能不是。
lines.en: At night do not chase noises in the woods. Usually a badger. Usually.

lines.speaker: 护林人
lines.cn: 林线以外的事定了以后，界桩挪了半步。就半步。
lines.en: The tree-line case closed, and the boundary post moved half a step. Half a step.

lines.speaker: 矿工
lines.cn: 金价之外，还有命价。矿上先算金，后算人。
lines.en: Beyond the gold price there is the price of a life. The mine counts gold first, people second.

lines.speaker: 矿工
lines.cn: 井下的水要抽，抽水的钱要有人出。谁出，年年吵。
lines.en: The water below must be pumped, and someone pays for the pumping. Who pays is argued every year.

lines.speaker: 看守
lines.cn: 夜里矿井口留一盏灯。灯灭过两回，两回都出事。
lines.en: One lamp stays at the shaft mouth at night. It went out twice, and both times something happened.

lines.speaker: 矿工
lines.cn: 金价的事过去以后，井口多了块牌子：先算人。牌子新，字旧。
lines.en: After the gold-price business a sign went up at the shaft: count people first. New sign, old words.

lines.speaker: 乡民
lines.cn: 兽死之后，地归谁种，吵了整整一个冬天。
lines.en: After the beast died, who farms the land was argued the whole winter.

lines.speaker: 农人
lines.cn: 纪念的事有人记，地的事有人抢。两件事不是一件事。
lines.en: Some remember the memorial; others grab the land. Not the same matter.

lines.speaker: 乡民
lines.cn: 夜里别走旧猎径。那路上的坑是旧的，人是新的。
lines.en: Do not take the old hunting path at night. The pits are old; the people are new.

lines.speaker: 农人
lines.cn: 兽死之后的事办完，地界重新量过。量地的人喝了三壶酒。
lines.en: With the aftermath done, the boundary was re-measured. The surveyor drank three jugs.

lines.speaker: 关兵
lines.cn: 关口两边，一边看文书，一边看人。两边都累。
lines.en: Both sides of the pass: one reads papers, one reads people. Both are tired.
lines.link: 聚落_PAS_柏石关与关外聚落

lines.speaker: 乡民
lines.cn: 关外种的粮，进关要交一次。交了才叫粮，不交叫私货。
lines.en: Grain grown outside the pass pays once to enter. Pay and it is grain; do not and it is contraband.
lines.link: 聚落_PAS_柏石关与关外聚落

lines.speaker: 关兵
lines.cn: 夜里关楼只留一个火盆。火盆一挪，就是换岗。
lines.en: At night the gate tower keeps one brazier. Move the brazier and the watch changes.
lines.link: 聚落_PAS_柏石关与关外聚落

lines.speaker: 乡民
lines.cn: 关口两边的事谈完以后，粮车排得比从前直。
lines.en: After the two sides talked, the grain carts queued straighter than before.
lines.link: 聚落_PAS_柏石关与关外聚落

lines.speaker: 护理者
lines.cn: 不是空床的村庄，床是留给人的，不是留给数的。
lines.en: A village of no empty beds: beds are kept for people, not for numbers.
lines.link: 聚落_ASH_寒凉盆地与护理村

lines.speaker: 乡民
lines.cn: 盆地的风从北边来，晒的衣裳要压石头。
lines.en: The basin wind comes from the north. Laundry needs stones on it.
lines.link: 聚落_ASH_寒凉盆地与护理村

lines.speaker: 护理者
lines.cn: 夜里查房两回。第二回是听，不是看。
lines.en: Two rounds at night. The second round is for listening, not looking.
lines.link: 聚落_ASH_寒凉盆地与护理村

lines.speaker: 乡民
lines.cn: 床位的事定了以后，门口的名册还是手写的。手写慢，改得清。
lines.en: With the bed matter closed, the list at the door stayed handwritten. Slow, and clear to amend.
lines.link: 聚落_ASH_寒凉盆地与护理村

lines.speaker: 药农
lines.cn: 回程也是答案。上山的人先想好怎么下来。
lines.en: The way back is also an answer. Before climbing, plan the descent.

lines.speaker: 挑夫
lines.cn: 山道上的药棚不问来历，只问你要不要水。
lines.en: The shed on the trail asks no names, only whether you want water.

lines.speaker: 挑夫
lines.cn: 夜里雾从谷底上来。看见雾，就找石头坐着等。
lines.en: At night fog climbs from the valley. See the fog and find a stone to sit and wait.

lines.speaker: 药农
lines.cn: 回程的事办完以后，药棚多挂了一盏灯。
lines.en: The descent case closed, and the shed hung one more lamp.

lines.speaker: 学者
lines.cn: 留下来的城里，学院的门照旧开。开给谁，另说。
lines.en: In the city that stayed, the college doors open as before. For whom is another matter.

lines.speaker: 市民
lines.cn: 曼恩的墙比别处厚。厚墙也挡不住风向变。
lines.en: Maen's walls are thicker than elsewhere. Thick walls do not stop the wind from turning.

lines.speaker: 市民
lines.cn: 夜里学院那边安静得过头。安静的地方，人容易多想。
lines.en: The college quarter is too quiet at night. Quiet places breed thinking.

lines.speaker: 学者
lines.cn: 去留的事定下以后，名册上划掉了三个名字，又添了两个。
lines.en: With staying and leaving decided, three names were struck from the roll and two added.
